risks: Supplier cost is an optimistic estimate (Rs 140/piece); at the Srinagar Rs 199/piece listing the set costs Rs 597, about 40% of Rs 1,499, and would likely fail the 30% margin rule
Retail is UNVALIDATED on Amazon.in/Flipkart; Rs 1,499 relies on specialist D2C prices (iTokri, Exotic India), which a marketplace buyer may not pay
Price is above the preferred Rs 449-999 band; at Rs 999 the Rs 420 cost is 42% and fails
Jammu and Kashmir supplier, so website-only under docs/05; no Odisha maker found; long courier transit from Srinagar
Hand-painted lacquer can chip or crack in transit and colours vary piece to piece; needs a sample, padded packing and 'handmade variation' wording to limit returns
Papier mache is a GI-registered craft (Kashmir Paper Machie); do not claim GI or 'authentic' without the supplier's GI authorised-user certificate
Many 'papier mache' boxes are painted wood or MDF; the material claim needs supplier evidence
GST: handicraft papier mache assumed 5% after the Sept 2025 rate changes; HSN (4823/9602 or similar) to be confirmed by the CA

review.notes: No hard-rule breach (home_storage preferred, not glass, le_1kg, Rs 1,499 above floor) and no papier mache 3-set at or below Rs 700 found on Amazon.in, Flipkart or Meesho on 2026-11-23, so not undercut on present evidence; margin passes on Shopify at Rs 420 (52.3%) and also at a Rs 600 set cost (39.2%). But the Rs 140 figure is listed per piece on a 'Box Set' listing (per box vs per set unresolved, and a comparable Apty Crafty 'Box Set' is Rs 600/piece), the Rs 1,499 retail rests only on D2C anchors (iTokri inferred Rs 1,650, Exotic India USD), and genuine papier mache (not painted cardboard/MDF) and transit durability are unproven, so a written S/M/L set quote, material evidence and a padded-shipped sample are needed before spending.

'Piece' on a 'Box Set' listing is ambiguous: Rs 140 could be one box (set Rs 420) or the whole set; sizes and MOQ not shown; pages not opened. Realistic matched S/M/L set cost on this evidence is Rs 420-750 (3 x Rs 140 up to 3 x Rs 250); the Apty Crafty Rs 600 'set' listing suggests about Rs 600. recommend.py evaluate() at Rs 600: Shopify margin 39.17%, expected Rs 514.45 (PASS); at Rs 420: 52.33%, Rs 687.25.
review.complaint_patterns: 2026-11-23 search found no Kashmiri-papier-mache-specific complaint data. Generic papier mache boxes: HobbyCraft buyer received a dented, bent 22cm box and another reported declining quality (https://www.hobbycraft.co.uk/mache-box-22cm/615662-1000, https://www.hobbycraft.co.uk/mache-square-tissue-box-12cm/608900-1000); Novica reviewers reported 'doesn't look like the picture' and shape differing from the photo (https://www.novica.com/p/decorative-papier-mache-elephant-motif-box/405977/). No chipped-paint or cracked-lacquer reports found, but evidence is thin; recommend.py flags the item fragile. Painted cardboard/MDF sold as papier mache is an unverified but plausible risk at Rs 140.
